Answer: B
Reason: The provided CT images (sagittal and axial) demonstrate a widened mediastinum with periaortic soft tissue density/hematoma, which is the radiographic correlate of the "mediastinal widening" seen on chest X-ray in blunt thoracic aortic injury. This finding indicates significant peri-aortic hemorrhage consistent with traumatic aortic injury, necessitating the stent placement mentioned in the history.
